geo_basis: London court, as the article states
title: Lapsus$ member Arion Kurtaj reportedly sentenced to seven years in London and released under supervision
summary: Mobidevices (republished by Zazoom) reports that a London court on 23 November sentenced Arion Kurtaj, the Lapsus$ member behind the 2022 Rockstar Games GTA 6 leak, to seven years, counting time in a psychiatric hospital and in custody, and released him the same day under supervision. It says he pleaded guilty on 16 November. No court or police page was read.
plain: A report says a London court gave GTA 6 leaker Arion Kurtaj a seven-year sentence on 23 November but released him under supervision the same day, counting time already spent in hospital and custody.
exec: Reported enforcement outcome in the 2022 Rockstar Games hack; single report, not confirmed by a court or police page.

validation.note: Only Mobidevices (republished by Zazoom, one report) was read; a search found no court, police or BBC page to confirm it.
